result.report:
Split the WhatsApp block into three scenarios to match the vault flow and remove the fixed-text 'validacao' screen.

scenarios.ts: replaced the single 'whatsapp' entry + 'validacao' with three entries: 'whatsapp' (intro/orientation, eyebrow "Antes de conectar" to avoid duplicating the "WhatsApp" block-progress label), 'whatsapp-conectar' (the connection panel, same copy the old 'whatsapp' scenario had), and 'whatsapp-concluido' (the no-WhatsApp completion screen, using the exact vault copy from docs/product-vault/02-Fluxos/01-Onboarding.md §9-10).

blocks.ts: blockScenarios.whatsapp now lists all three scenarios; onboardingFlow keeps 'whatsapp' → 'whatsapp-conectar' as the sequential path and excludes 'whatsapp-concluido' as a branch reached only via skip (same treatment as 'minha-agenda-conectar'). progressPercent returns 100 for 'whatsapp-concluido'.

blocks/whatsapp.tsx: whatsappStepBody now renders the 4 vault points (docs/product-vault/02-Fluxos/02-Ativacao-e-Teste-do-WhatsApp.md §"Orientação sobre número pessoal") as a list for 'whatsapp', the untouched WhatsAppConnectionPanel for 'whatsapp-conectar', and nothing for 'whatsapp-concluido' (title/description alone carry the vault copy). persistWhatsappStep: 'whatsapp' just navigates to 'whatsapp-conectar'; 'whatsapp-conectar' checks the real connection status and, if connected, completes onboarding and replaces the route with /inicio directly (no more intermediate 'validacao' screen with hard-coded "Configurado" strings). New exported skipWhatsappStep completes onboarding via getProductServices().onboarding.complete() + refreshSession(), then navigates to 'whatsapp-concluido'.

OnboardingScreen.tsx: added scenario-specific action branches — 'whatsapp' renders "Fazer isso depois" (calls the new local skip() → skipWhatsappStep) and "Conectar meu WhatsApp" (submit); 'whatsapp-concluido' renders the two vault links ("Conectar agora" → /configuracoes/whatsapp, "Ir para o início" → /inicio) instead of the generic Continuar/Voltar pair; the generic submit label shows "Concluir configuração" for 'whatsapp-conectar' (was for 'validacao').

OnboardingRuntime.tsx: nextRequiredStep's fallback (WhatsApp already connected) now points to 'whatsapp-conectar' instead of the removed 'validacao'.

atendly.css: added `.onboarding-points` (and child rules) for the 4-point orientation list, reusing existing tokens (--border, --accent).

tests/goal018-onboarding-reachability.test.tsx (owned by WU-07, necessarily updated since it exercised the exact scenarios being restructured): bumped onboardingOrder length 14→15; replaced the 'whatsapp conectado avança para validacao' / 'whatsapp sem conexão...' / 'validacao conclui...' tests with equivalents on the new scenario split, and added coverage for the intro's 4 points, the skip path, the whatsapp-concluido copy/links, and nextRequiredStep's new fallback.

Confirmed no other reference to 'validacao' remains in apps/frontend (Grep, zero matches).

Commands run: `npx vitest run tests/goal018-onboarding-reachability.test.tsx` (43/43 passed, twice — before and after Prettier fix), `npx vitest run` full suite (396/396 passed), `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` (clean), `npx eslint src/features/onboarding tests/goal018-onboarding-reachability.test.tsx` (clean), `npx prettier --write` on the 7 changed files (whitespace-only reflow, re-verified tests still pass after).
result.summary: Split the WhatsApp onboarding block into orientation, connect, and no-WhatsApp-completion scenarios per the vault, removing the fixed-text 'validacao' screen; 396/396 frontend tests and typecheck pass.
